description_short.value: Ghanaian universal bank providing corporate and retail banking; a subsidiary of Nigeria's Access Bank Plc.
description_short.source: Written by us from the Access Bank (Ghana) Plc 2025 Annual Report (reporting entity note)

description_full.value: Access Bank (Ghana) Plc holds a universal banking licence from the Bank of Ghana. Its principal activity is corporate and retail banking. It was incorporated in Ghana in July 2008 and has been listed on the Ghana Stock Exchange since December 2016. Its parent, Access Bank Plc of Nigeria, held 93.4% of its shares at the end of 2025, with the bank's staff share scheme holding a further 2.6%.
